caveats: candidate gates are the best point of each cell's own fit curve after examining 1682 hypotheses - heavy selection
new_format OU25 historical prices are best-of-books (11% of rows with two-way margin < 0) - historical ROI inflated
rows between discovery and forward_start are reported as POST_DISCOVERY and never count toward a pass

hypotheses.edge_definition: production raw edge (OU25 p-1/odds; side p-(1/odds)/1.08) on the side v9 picks
hypotheses.statistical_test: flat 1u ROI, 95% matchday block bootstrap; one-sided t for BH
hypotheses.multiple_comparison_family: H-GATE-* (all candidates in this registry), Benjamini-Hochberg q<=0.10
hypotheses.pass_criterion: n>=min_forward_n AND matchdays>=10 AND ROI 95% CI lower > 0 AND BH q<=0.10 AND (CLV mean>=0 where close coverage>=50%) -> FORWARD_SUPPORTED
hypotheses.fail_criterion: n>=min_forward_n AND ROI 95% CI upper < 0 -> REJECTED; or n>=2*min_forward_n AND ROI<=0 -> REJECTED
hypotheses.status: DISCOVERY (source registry gives no candidate gate - nothing to test)
hypotheses.production_behaviour: UNCHANGED - this is a forward test on the all-fixture shadow, never a live gate
